subject: Index of association from whole genome variants

messages.author: feef5d8531c22483
messages.subject: Index of association from whole genome variants
parts:
Dear Zhain,

I would like to estimate linkage disequilibrium/index of association among the individual/population. I am working in the whole genome variants and my unit file is multi-sample vcf file which I produce by joint varients calling using freebayes.
I see that to estimate index of association with poppr, the recombed r-objects are genclone/genind. I was wondering if I could convert the whole genome variant file to either of these objects. If yes, what is the best way to convert a vcf file to either genclone or genind objects? I only know that a vcf file can be converted to genlight. I tried to use genlinght to estimate the index of association but it through error. 

Thanks 
Ram

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Index of association from whole genome variants
parts:
Hi,

If you have a genlight object, you can estimate the index of association with one of the following:

win.ia()

samp.ia()

bitwise.ia()

These will calculate IA across windows, random samples, and your whole sample, respectively. Be careful when using bitwise.ia(), however because if you have a large number of loci, you may run into a large number problem.

Best,Zhian
